pre_session_tools.name: check_open
pre_session_tools.description: Works out whether the office is open right now and when it next opens.

post_call_analysis_data.name: trip_request
post_call_analysis_data.description: True if the caller asked to book a new ride.

post_call_analysis_data.name: rider_name
post_call_analysis_data.description: Full name of the person riding.

post_call_analysis_data.name: caller_name
post_call_analysis_data.description: Name of the caller if different from the rider, with relationship or facility (e.g. 'Mary, daughter' or 'Jo, case manager at OSF').

post_call_analysis_data.name: callback_number
post_call_analysis_data.description: Best callback number the caller confirmed.

post_call_analysis_data.name: pickup_address
post_call_analysis_data.description: Pickup address including unit and driver notes.

post_call_analysis_data.name: destination
post_call_analysis_data.description: Destination name and address.

post_call_analysis_data.name: appointment_datetime
post_call_analysis_data.description: Appointment date and time as stated, plus the actual date.

post_call_analysis_data.name: trip_type
post_call_analysis_data.description: Kind of trip requested.

post_call_analysis_data.name: recurring
post_call_analysis_data.description: Recurring schedule if any (e.g. 'dialysis Mon/Wed/Fri'), else empty.

post_call_analysis_data.name: mobility
post_call_analysis_data.description: Rider mobility.

post_call_analysis_data.name: companions
post_call_analysis_data.description: Who rides along, if anyone.

post_call_analysis_data.name: payer
post_call_analysis_data.description: How the ride will be paid.

post_call_analysis_data.name: medicaid_plan
post_call_analysis_data.description: Health plan name if Medicaid.

post_call_analysis_data.name: special_needs
post_call_analysis_data.description: Oxygen, help to the door, stairs, sedation, or other notes.

post_call_analysis_data.name: urgent
post_call_analysis_data.description: True for: rider waiting or late driver, ready for pickup, same-day discharge, same-day ride or same-day cancellation, or a complaint about a current ride.

post_call_analysis_data.name: urgent_reason
post_call_analysis_data.description: Why it's urgent.

post_call_analysis_data.name: booking_change
post_call_analysis_data.description: Change to an existing ride.

post_call_analysis_data.name: change_details
post_call_analysis_data.description: Details of the change requested.

post_call_analysis_data.name: message_taken
post_call_analysis_data.description: True if a message or callback request was taken.

post_call_analysis_data.name: reason
post_call_analysis_data.description: One-sentence reason for the call.

post_call_analysis_data.name: unanswered_question
post_call_analysis_data.description: Any question the assistant couldn't answer.

post_call_analysis_data.name: transferred
post_call_analysis_data.description: True if the call was transferred to the team.

post_call_analysis_data.name: emergency
post_call_analysis_data.description: True if the caller was told to call 911.
